recognize_zh: 單顆大型中性球核分成六葉以上（hypersegmented），細胞質有細緻顆粒，旁邊還有淚滴狀紅血球；此圖呈現的是顆粒球系發育異常，而非單核球增多本身，需結合全片單核球計數才支持 CMML。
features: Large segmented neutrophil with hypersegmented nucleus (about 6 or more lobes)
Coarsely clumped chromatin in lobes connected by thin filaments
Abundant cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; granulation not reduced
Background red cells include a teardrop cell and mild anisocytosis
Scattered small platelets; no monocytes in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil with a hypersegmented nucleus composed of multiple small lobes and cytoplasm with fine granules. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with a teardrop form, and platelets are present. No monocytes are included in this field, so the defining monocytosis cannot be evaluated here. Nuclear hypersegmentation may represent dysgranulopoiesis in a myeloid neoplasm such as chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, but megaloblastic change should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows macro-ovalocytes and several hypersegmented neutrophils with normal vitamin levels excluding it; CMML additionally shows monocytosis.
Drug-induced hypersegmentation is explained by history and accompanied by macrocytosis rather than monocytosis.
Pelger-Huet dysplasia shows hyposegmented bilobed or nonlobed nuclei, the opposite of the hypersegmented nucleus here.
Constitutional hypersegmentation is present in all neutrophils without cytopenias or dysplasia in other lineages.
